content.title: Delhi Pollution Control Committee (DPCC) Tightens Pollution Norms for Yamuna River
content.caption: The Delhi Pollution Control Committee (DPCC) has introduced stricter pollution control measures for the Yamuna river in Delhi, aiming to improve water quality and prevent environmental pollution.

slides.heading: Delhi Pollution Control Committee (DPCC) Tightens Pollution Norms for Yamuna
slides.text: The Delhi Pollution Control Committee (DPCC) has introduced stricter pollution control measures for the Yamuna river in Delhi, aiming to improve water quality and prevent environmental pollution.

slides.heading: Yamuna River Pollution
slides.text: The Yamuna river in Delhi is facing severe pollution issues, with the Delhi Pollution Control Committee (DPCC) introducing stricter regulations.

slides.heading: DPCC Measures
slides.text: The DPCC has tightened pollution control measures for dairy farms, gaushalas, dhobi ghats, and laundry units, aiming to improve water quality and prevent environmental pollution.
